title: Reporting Analyst
description:
About IntouchCX
  
  

IntouchCX is a global leader in digital customer experience management, back office processing, trust \& safety solutions, and AI services. For over 25 years, we’ve scaled with soul, building trusted long\-term partnerships and empowering our people to drive positive change.
  
  

About the Job
  
We are changing the way people think about customer care, and we need your help!
  
Are you passionate about performance and love the challenge of reporting and diagnosing trends in key performance metrics? We’re looking for a Reporting Analyst with strong problem solving skills who can thrive in a fast paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  
  

As Reporting Analyst, You Will…
  
* Be responsible for real\-time reporting and diagnosing trends in key performance metrics
* Generate weekly and daily KPI reports
* Ensure employee data is current and accurate for assigned program
* Work in partnership with Operational Leaders and Program Leadership


As Reporting Analyst, You Have…
  
* High School Diploma or equivalent is required
* Experience in leadership and working in a supervisory role
* Advanced knowledge of MS Word, Excel and Google Docs
* Proficiency with formulas and pivot tables
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to enter data with a high level of accuracy
* Adaptability to learn a variety of software programs (such as Javascript)
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Flexibility to work evenings and weekends if needed


IntouchCX will never ask for payment, money, financial or banking information during the recruitment process. We only communicate through official channels.
  
  

Should you receive a suspicious job offer, or posting, from anyone claiming to be an IntouchCX employee, please report it immediately to hr@intouchcx.com for review and validation.

title: Enforcement Detection Analyst, YouTube, Trust and Safety
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
* 2 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience or demonstrated interest in anti\-abuse operations at scale.
* Track record of leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI technologies to solve business problems.
* Ability to work with a variety of stakeholders to gather requirements, explain models and iterate to make improvements.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical abilities with a history of going above and beyond to make operational improvements and solve tough problems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


Fast\-paced, dynamic, and proactive, YouTube’s Trust \& Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world to create, and express themselves. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust \& Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever\-evolving digital world.



At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun.
YouTube’s Trust and Safety team is dedicated to making YouTube a safe place for users, viewers, and content creators around the world. Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust and Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever\-evolving digital world.


As an Enforcement Detection Analyst , you will be directly responsible for ensuring that we effectively identify and remove disruptive content and users as quickly as possible, in an environment where hundreds of hours of new content is uploaded every minute. The primary focus is abuse within the YouTube Partner Program.


At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and implement strategies and solutions to enforce YouTube policies at scale. Provide data\-driven insights and recommendations for effective abuse prevention and enforcement. Leverage Machine Learning and AI, as appropriate.
* Collaborate closely with stakeholders and partners in Engineering, Product, Policy and Operations to drive complex anti\-abuse solutions involving and impacting various cross\-functional areas.
* Provide rapid incident response for abuse problems, operating independently. Analyze and draw conclusions on root\-causes and define and implement mitigation steps.
* Learn complex and technical concepts and systems and deliver meaningful results using them. Communicate technical results and methods clearly.
* Design and refine LLM solutions and agents to improve accuracy of identifying and classifying abusive content and behavior.

title: Analyst – Learning & Development Operations
description:
**Job Description**  

As the Analyst – Learning \& Development Operations, you will play a pivotal role in executing learning operational strategies and managing learning systems for the L\&D Center of Excellence (CoE). This role ensures the effectiveness of learning solutions, stakeholder satisfaction, and fosters a culture of continuous learning through collaboration with key stakeholders. You will oversee critical L\&D programs, process improvements, technology implementation, and learning service delivery.

**Key Competencies**


These competencies represent the skills, knowledge, and abilities required to excel in this role.

**Learning Technologies and Automation**


Expertise in digital learning tools and automation is essential for delivering scalable, efficient, and impactful learning experiences. This competency ensures the organization leverages technology for continuous learning and operational excellence.

* Proficiency in learning management systems (LMS), Learning Experience Platforms (LxP), and related technologies
* Ability to administer learning systems, including assigning training, managing curricula, and maintaining training records
* Understanding of integration between Learning \& Talent Systems, HRIS, and content providers
* Skill in executing automation initiatives to streamline learning processes

**Operational Execution**


Strong operational execution ensures learning programs run smoothly, align with business goals, and deliver measurable results. This competency is critical for maintaining high standards and stakeholder satisfaction.

* Ability to follow standardized global processes and ensure accurate documentation
* Proficiency in managing incidents, escalations, and recurring issues
* Capability to serve as system administrator for key learning tools

**Learning Analytics**


Competence in learning analytics enables data\-driven decision\-making and continuous improvement of learning initiatives.

* Skill in utilizing data analytics tools to measure learning effectiveness and identify trends

**Collaboration \& Communication**


Effective collaboration and communication are vital for gathering requirements, engaging stakeholders, and ensuring successful project delivery.

* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-driven environment

**Key Responsibilities**


These are the primary day\-to\-day tasks and deliverables for this role.

* Manage multiple learning projects, balancing timelines, quality standards, and stakeholder expectations
* Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to gather requirements and translate them into effective learning solutions
* Plan, execute, and evaluate learning and development programs, including pilot programs, rollouts, assessments, and learner enrollment
* Execute automation initiatives to streamline learning processes
* Serve as system administrator for key learning tools, including updates, release, and change management
* Conduct periodic reviews and updates to ensure alignment with learning goals
* Leverage learning analytics and feedback for continuous improvement of learning outcomes
* Support knowledge and capability building within the team

  

**Qualifications** **Essential**

* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in a relevant field
* Minimum 3 years of professional experience in core Learning Delivery \& Operations roles with an understanding of GXP, CFR 21 Part 11 Compliance
* Experience with Learning Management Systems (SumTotal / Cornerstone) and Learning Experience Platforms (Percipio)
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-driven environment

**Preferred**

* Intermediate to proficient knowledge in MS Excel and analytics tools
* Experience with content providers such as Coursera, LinkedIn Learning, Skillsoft, Aperian Globesmart, etc.
* Experience using ticketing tools like Leena.AI, ServiceNow, etc.

title: Risk Analyst
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

**Job Description**
===================

**Who we are**


With over $2\.5 trillion of assets under management, Invesco is one of the world’s leading global investment management firms, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. Spreading across 26 countries and with over 8400 dedicated employees, we are driven by trust and care. As one of the world’s leading asset managers, we are solely dedicated to delivering an investment experience that helps people get more out of life. If you're looking for challenging work, thoughtful colleagues, and a global employer with social values, explore your potential at Invesco.

**Your Team**


The Risk Measurement Team owns and manages a global portfolio risk data platform (MSCI RiskMetrics) that provides ex\-ante market risk measurement, stress\-testing and liquidity risk data to a plethora of stakeholders (Investment Risk Management, Risk Oversight, Product Development, Legal and Compliance, Client Reporting). Risk Measurement is a 2nd line of defence function owning the ex\-ante market and liquidity risk models for Regulatory Risk.

**Your Role**

* Under the guidance of the APAC Risk Measurement TL contribute to build and maintain an integrated risk measurement infrastructure that reflects the Global risk monitoring needs.
* Ensure risk measurement capabilities and outputs are continuously improved and adjusted based on the evolution of the regulatory, statutory, or corporate portfolio risk measurement requirements.
* Monitor, analyze and report market risk, liquidity risk, leverage across global funds.
* Provide comprehensive and high\-quality portfolio risk measurement, analysis, and reporting.
* Collaborate with the global Risk Measurement teams as well as the other Investment Risk functions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the global platform.
* Provide expert support to all stakeholders in research/quantitative/qualitative analysis of portfolios.
* Provide expertise in terms of local products, investment processes, trading strategies, market characteristics.
* Develop expert level understanding of the markets in general and potential impact on portfolio risk.
* Ensure all activities are in line with Invesco’s Conduct principles.

**The Experience You Bring**

* 2\-4 years of experience in Marker Risk/Liquidity Risk
* Understanding of risk models and statistics such as VaR, Volatility, Tracking Error etc.
* Sound understanding of financial instruments at theoretical level incl. pricing methodologies for derivatives.
* Working knowledge of at least one programming languages like SQL, Python, etc
* Knowledge of risk systems such BarraOne, Blackrock Aladdin, Axioma would be a plus.

title: Recon Conversion Analyst​ - Senior Manager
description:
We are seeking a seasoned leader with a proven track record in managing Data Conversion (IBOR) within large\-scale, client\-facing transformation programs. The Officer will play a pivotal role in the Alpha Global Conversion Practice, overseeing strategy, planning, execution, and governance of end\-to\-end platform IBOR Conversion during Alpha implementations. These programs span complex business models and data flows across front, middle, and back office operations involving State Street, Charles River Development, clients, and industry partners.


**Why this role is important to us**

Alpha is the industry’s first global interoperable platform that unifies front, middle, and back office functions under one provider. Thorough Conversion of Alpha’s applications, data, and workflows is essential to accelerate implementation timelines, ensure consistent delivery, and provide a seamless client experience. The Officer will be instrumental in driving this transformation and ensuring high\-quality outcomes.


Specifically, the candidate will:


* Work with Business Leads to training, resolve questions, assess user needs and recommend changes
* Work on data analysis and data conversion of new Clients to an in\-house Middle Office system
* Work on the data conversion development lifecycle and methodology. This includes requirements analysis, solution design, client acceptance, timeline creation, implementation, unit testing, deployment tools, and maintenance
* Understand the current processes and tools used by State Street, and map new requirements to this tool
* Ability to create data maps, to map the data flow from legacy systems to the in\-house systems using existing functionality and processes
* Work on inputs and outputs from the conversion process, and communicate issues internally and externally as required
* Resolve issues and gaps in terms of data provided or discrepancies in data between legacy presentation and the future state model basis the feedback provided
* Work on the deliverables of conversion planning and testing in order to meet the milestones
* Participate in the actual conversion tests and dress rehearsals

**The ideal candidate should have:**

* Overall 12 to 18 Years of Industry Experience
* Good knowledge and experience in Capital markets – Middle, Back Office \& Front office is key
* 9\+ years of relevant Financial Industry Experience required, preferably Investment Management, Asset Management
* Great Understanding of Securities, Loans, IBOR/ABOR, Transaction Management
* Fair understanding \& experience on platforms like IBOR/ABOR, Eagle, Eagle Star, PAM, Portia, CRD
* Good Communication Skills with good external and internal client interfacing skills
* Manage a team of 10\-20 to meet onboarding goals
* Ability to work in a high paced environment, be flexible, follow tight deadlines, organize and prioritize work
* Ability to analyze and resolve project\-related issues and follow through with set objectives
* Experience working on projects related to Middle \& Back Office Client On boarding
* Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Access skills, as well as Microsoft Project or other project management software experience
* Bachelor’s Degree in Finance \& Accounting, Computer Science, Information Technology
* Nice to have :MBA in Finance, Management, Business Administration from Premier B School

**About State Street**

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. title: MIS Data Analyst & Automation Specialist
description:
About the Role: We are looking for a high\-impact MIS Data Analyst to take complete ownership of our revenue data pipelines, marketing attribution, and sales floor workflow automation. You will turn raw, siloed multi\-platform datasets into clean, actionable intelligence that drives operational efficiency and real\-time decision\-making across leadership.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, build, and maintain automated workflow pipelines, ETL processes, and database queries using Python, SQL, and Google Apps Script to completely eliminate manual reporting friction.
* Scale and optimize real\-time executive dashboards in Power BI and Looker Studio to track lead distribution, sales team response times, conversion funnels, and operational KPIs.
* **Audit and analyze multi\-channel marketing data (Meta Ads, TeleCRM) to evaluate campaign performance, track Cost Per Qualified Lead (CPQL), and prevent wasted ad spend.**
* Partner directly with Sales Ops and Performance Marketing to build custom tracking mechanisms, ensuring 100% data integrity, pipeline visibility, and transparency across the entire revenue engine
* Required Qualifications \& Skills
* **2 to 3\+ years of hands\-on professional experience in MIS, data analytics, or business intelligence environments.**
* Advanced technical proficiency in SQL, Advanced Excel/Google Sheets (complex Pivot Tables, Power Query, DAX), and scripting via Python or Google Apps Script.
* **Proven track record of building and deploying interactive executive dashboards and BI suites using Power BI or Looker Studio.**
* Strong analytical mindset with a solid grasp of data modeling, exploratory data analysis, and systematic data cleaning.
* Preferred Qualifications
* **A formal educational background (Bachelor's or Master's) in Statistics, Mathematics, or a quantitative discipline.**
* Prior domain experience working directly with CRM platforms like TeleCRM and marketing traffic sources like Meta Ads Manager.
* **Familiarity with cloud data warehousing concepts (BigQuery) or modern data pipeline frameworks like Medallion Architecture.**
* Experience operating in fast\-paced retail, e\-commerce, or high\-growth startup environments.

Pay: Up to ₹600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

When you attract people who have the DNA of pioneers and the DNA of explorers, you build a company of like\-minded people who want to invent. And that’s what they think about when they get up in the morning: how are we going to work backwards from customers and build a great service or a great product” – Jeff Bezos
  

Amazon.com’s success is built on a foundation of customer obsession. Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like a clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decision gets made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on Map? Is there a safe place? Can we make unattended delivery? Would signature be required? If the address is commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does customer have any special preference? What are other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing delivery associate’s route? Does delivery associate know locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of all of it lies quality of underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The person in this role will be a strong influencer who will ensure goal alignment with Technology, Operations, and Finance teams. This role will serve as the face of the organization to global stakeholders. This position requires a results\-oriented, high\-energy, dynamic individual with both stamina and mental quickness to be able to work and thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth global organization. Excellent communication skills and executive presence to get in front of VPs and SVPs across Amazon will be imperative.
  

  

Key Strategic Objectives: Amazon is seeking an experienced leader to own the vision for quality improvement through global address management programs. As a Business Intelligence Engineer of Amazon last mile quality team, you will be responsible for shaping the strategy and direction of customer\-facing products that are core to the customer experience. As a key member of the last mile leadership team, you will continually raise the bar on both quality and performance. You will bring innovation, a strategic perspective, a passionate voice, and an ability to prioritize and execute on a fast\-moving set of priorities, competitive pressures, and operational initiatives. You will partner closely with product and technology teams to define and build innovative and delightful experiences for customers. You must be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and have the ability to break complex problems down into steps that drive product development at Amazon speed. You will set the tempo for defect reduction through continuous improvement and drive accountability across multiple business units in order to deliver large scale high visibility/ high impact projects. You will lead by example to be just as passionate about operational performance and predictability as you will be about all other aspects of customer experience.
  

  

The successful candidate will be able to:
  

* Effectively manage customer expectations and resolve conflicts that balance client and company needs.
* Develop process to effectively maintain and disseminate project information to stakeholders.

  

  

* Be successful in a delivery focused environment and determining the right processes to make the team successful.

  

  

* This opportunity requires excellent technical, problem solving, and communication skills. The candidate is not just a policy maker/spokesperson but drives to get things done.

  

  

* Possess superior analytical abilities and judgment. Use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize and influence, show creativity, experimentation and innovation, and drive projects with urgency in this fast\-paced environment.

  

* Partner with key stakeholders to develop the vision and strategy for customer experience on our platforms. Influence product roadmaps based on this strategy along with your teams.

  

* Support the scalable growth of the company by developing and enabling the success of the Operations leadership team.

  

  

* Serve as a role model for Amazon Leadership Principles inside and outside the organization

  

  

* Actively seek to implement and distribute best practices across the operation
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2\+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
* Experience building and maintaining basic data artifacts (e.g., ETL, data models, queries)
* Experience applying basic statistical methods (e.g. regression) to difficult business problems
* Experience gathering business requirements, using industry standard business intelligence tool(s) to extract data, formulate metrics and build reports
* Track record of generating key business insights and collaborating with stakeholders

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of how to improve code quality and optimizes BI processes (e.g. speed, cost, reliability)
* Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
* Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools

Die Position
  
  

Job description
  
We are seeking a Principal Business Systems Analyst to help design, define, and scale technology solutions supporting commercial organizations across the US and global affiliates. You will operate at the intersection of business, product, data, and engineering, translating complex and ambiguous business problems into clear technical requirements and scalable solutions. You will partner with product managers, software engineers, data engineers, architects, data scientists, and commercial stakeholders across enterprise applications, data platforms, cloud services, analytics, APIs, and AI/GenAI capabilities. Hands\-on software development is not required, but strong technical fluency is essential.
  
Description of the area
  
360 Insights Engineering builds and evolves commercial technology, data, analytics, and AI capabilities used across the US and global affiliates. The team partners across markets to identify where capabilities should be globally standardized versus locally configurable, while accounting for differences in processes, data, regulations, and operating models.
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Partner with business and product leaders to understand complex commercial problems, lead discovery, challenge assumptions, and translate needs into clear functional and technical requirements.
* Define user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process flows, data requirements, system behaviors, and traceability from business objectives through implementation and validation.
* Decompose large, ambiguous initiatives into well\-defined capabilities and engineering\-ready requirements while proactively identifying scope, dependencies, edge cases, data issues, and operational risks.
* Serve as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, participating confidently in discussions on system architecture, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, data pipelines, integrations, authentication/authorization, and AI services.
* Partner with architects and engineers to evaluate solution approaches, technical constraints, dependencies, and trade\-offs, and review designs to ensure solutions satisfy business requirements and can scale across markets.
* Use SQL to investigate data, validate assumptions, troubleshoot issues, and support requirements definition, including relational models, joins, aggregations, data quality, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
* Translate analytical and reporting needs into clear data definitions, metrics, business rules, and transformations, partnering with data engineering and analytics teams on models, pipelines, reporting, and commercial analytics capabilities.
* Partner with product, engineering, and data science teams to identify AI/GenAI opportunities, translate them into measurable workflows, requirements, guardrails, and acceptance criteria, and ensure they solve real business problems.
* Apply working knowledge of LLMs, prompting, RAG, agents, model limitations, evaluation, and enterprise AI integration patterns when shaping AI\-enabled solutions.
* Support products serving the US, Canada, Brazil, and other global affiliates by coordinating requirements across markets and balancing global standardization with appropriate local configuration.
* Work effectively across distributed teams, functions, and time zones, driving alignment and clear decisions in complex, cross\-functional environments.


Qualifications
  
Education / Experience
  
  

* Experience as a Business Systems Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar technology\-facing role, with demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured technical requirements.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency with SQL and the ability to independently analyze and validate data.
* Strong experience with Jira and Confluence, including writing high\-quality user stories, acceptance criteria, requirements, and technical documentation.
* Experience partnering directly with software engineers, data engineers, architects, product managers, data scientists, and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical problem\-solving, written and verbal communication, ownership, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Experience operating across complex, distributed, or global organizations and managing multiple priorities and dependencies.


Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong understanding of REST APIs, system integrations, relational databases and data models, cloud\-based applications and services, distributed\-system fundamentals, authentication/authorization, data pipelines, and analytics platforms.
* Ability to read and reason about architecture diagrams, API specifications, data models, and system workflows.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP and modern cloud architecture patterns.
* Working knowledge of AI/GenAI concepts including LLMs, prompting, RAG, agents, model evaluation, model limitations, guardrails, and enterprise AI integration patterns.
* Ability to use GenAI tools to accelerate requirements analysis, research, documentation, data exploration, process mapping, solution design, and lightweight prototyping while critically validating generated outputs.
* Ability to recognize when AI should and should not be used, particularly with sensitive enterprise data, regulated information, and business\-critical decisions.
* Familiarity with commercial technology and data domains such as CRM, customer engagement, field operations, sales analytics, targeting/segmentation, marketing technology, or commercial data platforms.


Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Experience in commercial life sciences, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, healthcare technology, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting technology products across multiple countries or global business units is preferred.
* Experience defining or delivering AI/GenAI\-enabled products, including enterprise LLM, RAG, agent, or AI evaluation use cases, is preferred.
* Experience with large\-scale analytical platforms or complex enterprise datasets is preferred.
* Ability to create lightweight prototypes, workflow concepts, diagrams, analyses, and proof\-of\-concepts using AI\-enabled tools where appropriate.
* Continuously explores emerging AI capabilities and incorporates useful tools and techniques into day\-to\-day work.
* Experience in highly scaled technology, retail, or digital organizations such as Google, Meta, Amazon, or comparable companies is valued where candidates demonstrate strong product, data, and systems thinking.

title: Business Analyst II, GTS Field
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


About the Team  

  

The TESS (Transportation Execution Systems \& Services) Analytics team is part of NA Transportation Services and is responsible for delivering data\-driven insights, dashboards, automation, and governance solutions that support transportation configuration, network planning, and operational excellence. We partner closely with TESS Program Managers, Network Planners, Operations teams, and cross\-functional organizations including TITANS, SortTech, and ShipTech to drive measurable business outcomes.  

Role Summary  

  

We are seeking a Business Analyst to join the TESS Analytics team. In this role, you will build and maintain analytical solutions — including dashboards, reports, ETL pipelines, and automated monitoring systems — that enable TESS stakeholders to make faster, data\-informed decisions. You will work directly with Program Managers and Operations teams to translate business requirements into scalable analytics deliverables.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Key Responsibilities  

  

1\. Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports using Amazon QuickSight, supporting programs such as Config Validation, Quality Metrics, Klaxon Monitoring, and Network Planning  

2\. Develop and optimize SQL queries and ETL jobs (Datanet) to transform raw data into actionable datasets  

3\. Partner with TESS Program Managers to gather requirements, define KPIs, and deliver analytical solutions aligned to business goals  

4\. Support the Klaxon alarm system by building and maintaining automated monitoring dashboards that detect configuration defects (e.g., missing Stacking Filters, VSM misconfigurations)  

5\. Contribute to ETL governance initiatives — inventory management, deprecation workflows, and performance optimization  

6\. Perform ad\-hoc deep\-dive analyses to support root cause investigations, quality misses, and operational reviews (WBR, MBR)  

7\. Maintain data quality and integrity across TESS\-BI datasets through schema validation and standardization  

8\. Support on\-call BI operations including data queries, logic changes, and stakeholder requests  

9\. Document analytical processes, data dictionaries, and solution designs

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 5\+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* 3\+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience leveraging AI/GenAI tools and technologies to automate analytical workflows, derive insights from data, and improve business decision\-making.
